parsedContent.feedback: You provided the correct formula for operational gearing, but failed to calculate the contribution margin, operating profit, and operational gearing. Make sure to complete all the necessary calculations to arrive at the correct answer.
parsedContent.correctedAnswer: Contribution margin = Sales - Variable Costs = RWF1,000,000 - RWF600,000 = RWF400,000. Operating profit = Contribution margin - Fixed Costs = RWF400,000 - RWF300,000 = RWF100,000. Operational gearing = Contribution margin / Operating profit = RWF400,000 / RWF100,000 = 4
